description: Subcomponent for `v-audio` that draws an amplitude waveform and acts as the seek surface. Usable on its own with nothing but `peaks` and a model.

props.peaks: Precomputed amplitude values, normalized 0 to 1. Supplying them skips decoding entirely, which is the only path that works for cross-origin media.
props.buffered: Buffered ranges as flat `[start, end, …]` pairs in percent, drawn as a dimmed overlay beneath the played portion.
props.bars: Number of bars to draw. Longer `peaks` arrays are downsampled to fit; shorter ones are used as they are.
props.barWidth: Width of a single bar, relative to the bar geometry's own coordinate space.
props.barGap: Gap between bars, in the same units as `bar-width`.
props.barRadius: Corner radius of a single bar.
props.color: Color of the played portion. Falls back to the current text color.
props.trackColor: Color of the unplayed portion. Falls back to the current text color at a reduced opacity.
props.bufferColor: Color of the buffered overlay. Falls back to the current text color at a reduced opacity.
props.seekable: Allows the position to be changed by pointer and keyboard.
props.preview: Shows a cursor line and a time tooltip while hovering.
props.duration: Total duration in seconds, used for the tooltip and `aria-valuetext`. Without it both fall back to a percentage.
props.normalize: Rescales the peaks so the loudest bar reaches full height. Applied at render, so toggling it does not require decoding again.
props.sampleStrategy: How samples are reduced to one value per bar. `peak` preserves transients and suits speech; `rms` is smoother and suits music.
props.mirror: Reflects the waveform below the centre line at a reduced opacity.
props.step: Distance moved by the arrow keys, as a percentage. Page Up and Page Down move ten times as far.
props.disabled: Removes all interaction and dims the waveform.

events.start: Emitted when the user starts dragging.
events.end: Emitted when the user stops dragging.

slots.tooltip: Replaces the contents of the hover tooltip. Receives the formatted time and the hovered position.
